\section[(dialogue)]{Clothes, food and work — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R123-first-pass-clothes-food-and-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a dessert and a meal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a blanket; a ceiling, a towel, soap, a toothbrush, toothpaste
  \item a comb, a bin, a broom, a washing machine, an armchair
  \item an alarm clock, a mobile phone, a camera, glasses, an umbrella
  \item a purse, a ring, a chain; a necklace, a present, a photo
  \item a candle, a calendar, a jumper, a tie, gloves
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A blanket; a ceiling? (\textbf{die Decke}.) A towel? (\textbf{das Handtuch}.) Soap? (\textbf{die Seife}.) A toothbrush? (\textbf{die Zahnbürste}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{die Zahnpasta}.) A comb? (\textbf{der Kamm}.) A bin? (\textbf{der Mülleimer}.) A broom? (\textbf{der Besen}.) A washing machine? (\textbf{die Waschmaschine}.) An armchair? (\textbf{der Sessel}.) An alarm clock? (\textbf{der Wecker}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{das Handy}.) A camera? (\textbf{die Kamera}.) Glasses? (\textbf{die Brille}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{der Regenschirm}.) A purse? (\textbf{die Geldbörse}.) A ring? (\textbf{der Ring}.) A chain; a necklace? (\textbf{die Kette}.) A present? (\textbf{das Geschenk}.) A photo? (\textbf{das Foto}.) A candle? (\textbf{die Kerze}.) A calendar? (\textbf{der Kalender}.) A jumper? (\textbf{der Pullover}.) A tie? (\textbf{die Krawatte}.) Gloves? (\textbf{die Handschuhe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{School, free time and colours — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R123-second-pass-school-free-time-and-colours}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a scarf and boots.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a scarf, boots, a skirt, a coat, shoes
  \item socks, a blouse, beef, vegetables, a mushroom
  \item beans, a cucumber, a strawberry, a cherry, a melon
  \item garlic, flour, chocolate, a biscuit, a bread roll
  \item butter, a sauce, vinegar, a dessert, a meal
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A scarf? (\textbf{der Schal}.) Boots? (\textbf{die Stiefel}.) A skirt? (\textbf{der Rock}.) A coat? (\textbf{der Mantel}.) Shoes? (\textbf{die Schuhe}.) Socks? (\textbf{die Socken}.) A blouse? (\textbf{die Bluse}.) Beef? (\textbf{das Rindfleisch}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{das Gemüse}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{der Pilz}.) Beans? (\textbf{die Bohnen}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{die Gurke}.) A strawberry? (\textbf{die Erdbeere}.) A cherry? (\textbf{die Kirsche}.) A melon? (\textbf{die Melone}.) Garlic? (\textbf{der Knoblauch}.) Flour? (\textbf{das Mehl}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{die Schokolade}.) A biscuit? (\textbf{der Keks}.) A bread roll? (\textbf{das Brötchen}.) Butter? (\textbf{die Butter}.) A sauce? (\textbf{die Soße}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{der Essig}.) A dessert? (\textbf{der Nachtisch}.) A meal? (\textbf{die Mahlzeit}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
